url: Base URL of the OpenProject instance
urlInvalid: Please enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
apiTokenHelp: Create one under "My account" → "Access tokens" → "API" in OpenProject. Stored encrypted.
ignoreCertificateErrorsHelp: Only enable if the instance uses a self-signed certificate
ignoreCertificateErrorsWarning: Warning: with certificate verification disabled, an attacker could intercept traffic between the adapter and the server (man-in-the-middle) and read or alter data, including the API token. Only use this on trusted, internal networks.
requestTimeoutHelp: How long to wait for a response from OpenProject before giving up
testConnectionHint: Only works while the instance is running: shortly after saving this configuration (the instance then starts automatically for a few minutes) or right after a scheduled run. If the button is greyed out, the instance is currently not running.
testConnectionErrorAuth: Authentication failed (401/403) – check the API token
testConnectionErrorNotFound: API endpoint not found (404) – check the URL
testConnectionErrorTimeout: Timeout – instance unreachable or timeout too low
scheduleHint: The execution schedule is not configured here but in the "Schedule" tab of this instance (cron expression). Default: weekdays at 07:30.
warnDaysHelp: Work packages due within this many days are considered "due soon"
onlyAssignedToMe: Only work packages assigned to me
onlyAssignedToMeHelp: Refers to the user the API token belongs to
projectsHint: Leave empty to include all projects. The list is loaded live from OpenProject and requires a running instance (see the hint at "Test connection").
projectsHelp: Multi-select; if nothing is selected, all projects are included
maxResultsHelp: Limits how many open work packages are fetched per run
allListHint: In addition to "overdue" and "due soon", the adapter always provides ALL open work packages matching the criteria above under openproject.0.all.list/all.count - regardless of whether a due date is set at all. Useful if work packages are initially tracked as a plain to-do list without dates.
notifyInstanceHelp: Instance of a messaging adapter to notify through
notifyRecipientHelp: Optional: overrides the default recipient of the target instance, if supported
onlyOnChangeHelp: When enabled, an already reported work package is only reported again if its status or due date changed – the repeat lock is then ignored
repeatIntervalDaysHelp: How long an already reported, unchanged work package will not be reported again
